valueString.value: define "Qualifying Encounter during Measurement Period": ([Encounter: "Encounter Inpatient"] union [Encounter: "Emergency Department Visit"] union [Encounter: "Observation Services"] union [Encounter: class in {"emergency", "inpatient acute", "inpatient encounter", "inpatient non-acute", "short stay"}]) Encounters where Encounters.period overlaps "Measurement Period"

define "Qualifying Location during Measurement Period": [Encounter] Encounters where exists ( Encounters.location InitialPopulationLocation where Global.GetLocation(InitialPopulationLocation.location).type in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations" and InitialPopulationLocation.period during "Measurement Period" )
define "Initial Population": "Qualifying Encounter during Measurement Period" union "Qualifying Location during Measurement Period"
define "SDE Medication Request": [MedicationRequest] MedicationRequest with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation such that MedicationRequest.authoredOn during InitialPopulation.period
define "SDE Locations": [Location: type in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations"]

define "SDE Antibacterial Medications": [MedicationRequest] MedicationRequestWithCode with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation such that Global."Normalize Interval"(MedicationRequestWithCode.authoredOn) during InitialPopulation.period and MedicationRequestWithCode.status in {'active', 'completed'} and GetMedicationCode(MedicationRequestWithCode.medication) in "Antibacterial Medications"

define "SDE Body Weight Observation": [Observation: "body weight"] O with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation such that Global."Normalize Interval"(O.effective) during InitialPopulation.period and O.status in {'final'} with O.category category such that category ~"vital-signs"
define "SDE Encounter with Discharge Dispositions": "Initial Population" DischargeDispositions where DischargeDispositions.hospitalization.dischargeDisposition in "Discharge Disposition"
define "SDE EncounterDiagnosis Condition": [Condition] ConditionEncounterDiagnosis where true in HasCategoryEncounterDiagnosis(ConditionEncounterDiagnosis.category) and exists("Initial Population")

define "SDE HOB Labs": [Observation: "Bacterial and Fungal Blood Culture Tests"] HOBLabs with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation such that Global."Normalize Interval"(HOBLabs.effective) during InitialPopulation.period and HOBLabs.status ~ 'final'

define "SDE Medication Administration": [MedicationAdministration] MedicationAdministration with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation such that Global."Normalize Interval"(MedicationAdministration.effective) during InitialPopulation.period and MedicationAdministration.status ~ 'completed'
define "SDE Encounter with Discharge Diagnosis": "Initial Population" EncounterDD with EncounterDD.diagnosis diagnosis such that diagnosis.use ~ "Discharge Diagnosis"

define "SDE Body Height Observation": [Observation: "body height"] O with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation such that Global."Normalize Interval"(O.effective) during InitialPopulation.period and O.status in {'final'} with O.category category such that category ~"vital-signs"

define "SDE Condition": [Condition] Conditions with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation such that Global."Normalize Interval"(Conditions.onset) overlaps InitialPopulation.period and Conditions.clinicalStatus ~ Global."active"
define "SDE Payer": SDE."SDE Payer" Payer with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation such that start of Payer.period before end of InitialPopulation.period
define "SDE Encounter with Admit Source": "Initial Population" EncounterAdmitSource where EncounterAdmitSource.hospitalization.admitSource in "Admit Source"
define "SDE Specimen": [Specimen] Specimen with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation such that Global."Normalize Interval"(Specimen.collection.collected) during InitialPopulation.period
//Supplmental Data Elements define "SDE Chief Complaint": "Initial Population" EncounterCC with EncounterCC.diagnosis diagnosis such that diagnosis.use ~ "Chief Complaint"

rationale.value: The NHSN Hospital onset bacteremia (HOB) module provides a mechanism for facilities to report inpatient, emergency department (ED) and observation (OBS) encounters during a specified measurement period and to provide analytic reports based on these data to inform HOB patient safety events and quality improvement efforts. As additional data are collected by NHSN, an additional objective will be to facilitate inter-facility benchmarking and evaluate national-level trends of HOB events over time. The IP dQM provides the initial population and FHIR line-level data necessary for calculating the module metrics.

definition.value: Hospital-Onset HOB IP: All patients present in an inpatient location for at least one calendar day during the reporting month. Events assessed on or after hospital day 4.
Community-Onset HOB IP: All patients present in an inpatient location for at least one calendar day during the reporting month. Events assessed on prior to hospital day 4.
Measurement Period: From the first day of each calendar month through the last day of that calendar month.
